facts.business: TGV SRAAC Limited manufactures and sells caustic soda, chloromethanes, and related chemical products, and also operates power generation facilities including a thermal power plant and wind farm.
facts.related_party_note: The company is in compliance with Section 177 and 188 of the Act for all transactions with related parties, and details have been disclosed in Note 31 to the financial statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
